title: PCR Master Mix Aliquoting
author: Rodolfo A Salido Benitez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ua8eshw
materials: Platinum Hot Start PCR 2X Master Mix

steps.title: Prepare PCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the master mix in a sterile 10mL reservoir for every set of 384 samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 2,534 μl of Platinum Hot Start PCR 2X Master Mix to the reservoir.
Add 3,295 µL of PCR Clean Water to the reservoir.

steps.title: Set Up epMotion 5075 Worktable
steps.instruction: Configure the epMotion 5075 (Eppendorf, 5075000962) liquid handling deck according to the specified slots.

substeps.instruction: Place one box of 1-50µL epT.I.P.S. with filters on deck slot A4.
Place three empty 384 PCR Primer Plates on deck slots B1-B3.
Place the 10mL reservoir containing the PCR Master Mix in the first slot of the reservoir rack, then place the reservoir rack on deck slot B4.

steps.title: Execute Aliquoting Protocol
steps.instruction: Run the automated aliquot protocol using epBlue software (version 40.6 or later).

substeps.instruction: Import the protocol file 'Application_3XPCR_mastermix aliquot 4ul_384eppendorf_181003_105306.export6' into the epBlue software.
Execute the protocol to transfer 4.6 µL of PCR Master Mix into the three 384-well PCR plates using the multidispense feature.
